sentence: A card game where clues about one person in the chat are shown one at a time, and everyone else guesses who it is, scoring more points for guessing with fewer clues.
use_when: The group wants a quick guessing game about people in the chat
Someone asks to play guess who with clues
The group wants a light icebreaker where friends are the subject
People want a game with scores across several rounds
dont_use_when: The group needs a board game or a two player match
The group wants a poll or a vote on a decision
The group wants trivia or quiz questions about general topics
